title: FOMC decision (meeting Apr 27-28, no SEP) — the same two days as the Bank of Japan's April 2027 MPM
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes) and parsed out of the page's own 2027 panel, which reads verbatim "January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*" with the footnote "* Meeting associated with a Summary of Economic Projections." — so April 27-28 carries NO SEP. Page's own stamp: "Last Update: August 19, 2026". Filed estimate not for want of a primary but because the same page states verbatim "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it" — the 2027-03-16/17 meeting is the confirming venue — and because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Statement time assumed 14:00 ET per the standing convention, not separately sourced. Discovered during the boj-decision-2027-04-28 initial research, checked 2026-09-05
notes: Proposed during the boj-decision-2027-04-28 initial research (2026-09-05) because the +/-5-day adjacency window around that event returned EXACTLY ZERO tracked entries before this one — and the thing it had missed is a same-day FOMC. The Bank of Japan's April 2027 MPM is Apr 27-28 (boj-decision-2027-04-28, estimate, per boj.or.jp's own MPM schedule table parsed the same day), i.e. the identical two calendar days. Sequencing, on standing publication conventions rather than a sourced clock: the BoJ decision publishes at the meeting's conclusion around midday JST Wed Apr 28 (approx. 23:00 ET Tue Apr 27), the FOMC statement at 14:00 ET Wed Apr 28 (approx. 03:00 JST Thu Apr 29) — roughly fifteen hours apart, inside one US trading day. The asymmetry is the interesting half: this FOMC has no SEP while the BoJ meeting IS an Outlook Report meeting, so the Bank of Japan publishes a full three-year projection set that day and the Fed publishes none. Compounding it, Japan's Cabinet Office holiday file makes 2027-04-29 Showa Day (plus May 3/4/5), so the FOMC statement lands while Tokyo is closed and Japan's first chance to price EITHER central bank is the single Friday Apr 30 session before a further three-day close. The practical consequence recorded in that ledger: nothing in the Apr 28 US session or the Apr 30 Tokyo session may be attributed to the BoJ, the Fed, or the Outlook Report individually — the window does not contain enough independent sessions to separate them. SAME CHANNEL CAVEAT AS THE OTHER RATE ENTRIES: symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates- or FX-keyed; term premium is second-order and already owned by the FOMC ledgers. Estimate widens caution only. Two things for the pulses: confirm the date once the 2027-03-16/17 meeting ratifies the calendar, and check whether the blackout arithmetic holds (second Saturday before a Tuesday start = 2027-04-17), the same open question fomc-2027-01-27 carries.
